references.text: Prohibitions against sexual deviations are described as an 'abomination' (תוֹעֵבָה), the same Hebrew word used in Deut 22:5 regarding the mixing of gender roles.
Refers to actions that are an 'abomination' in the context of violating natural gender boundaries.
God created humans as male and female, establishing the fundamental difference between the sexes that Deut 22:5 seeks to preserve.
Paul discusses appropriate appearance for men and women, appealing to nature as a teacher about the distinction between the sexes.
Paul gives instructions on appropriate clothing for women, showing that there are biblical principles for gender-appropriate attire.
Uses the same expression 'an abomination to the Lord' (תוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה) as in 22:5, indicating that certain actions are detestable to God.
